text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Since I had the day off, I decided to check out some shops I was curious about.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I found the produce shop especially intriguing with the way they cut up the amount of vegetables you order right there on the spot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The moment they slice those big vegetables so cleanly is just… thrilling! It was a truly breathtaking experience. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Satono Diamond made the most of her day off.
